info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Transaction Switch Routing Decision-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of routing decisions for card transactions within the banking operational services. By leveraging this endpoint, financial institutions can enhance their transaction processing capabilities, ensuring optimal routing based on pre-defined criteria. Typical consumers include backend systems that manage payment processing and routing logic. The API supports various use cases, particularly for banks and payment processors seeking to streamline decision-making for card transactions.

post.summary: Create a routing decision for card transactions.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new routing decision specifically for card transactions in the operational services. It processes the request to determine the appropriate routing path based on the provided data.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the routing decisions for card transactions, utilized by the card transaction switch service. It should adhere to the specified schema and provide all required information for processing the transaction appropriately.
